title: Sarah Almehairi
description: Layers of colour, wood and paper become a language of geometric forms. Sarah Almehairi explores how materials, systems and abstraction can carry a story.

title: Bernhard Buhmann
description: Acrylic and oil on canvas create a vivid dialogue of painted forms and colour. Explore Bernhard Buhmann’s published paintings through CARBON 12.

title: Nour Malas
description: Oil and pastel create layered, gestural paintings in Nour Malas’s practice. Her published works bring colour, marks and shifting forms into an expressive surface.

title: Amba Sayal-Bennett
description: Sculptural forms and drawing sit at the centre of Amba Sayal-Bennett’s practice. Explore the shapes and material studies published by CARBON 12.

title: Shaikha Al Mazrou
description: Steel, copper and folded forms bring weight, tension and colour into conversation. Shaikha Al Mazrou makes sculptures and public installations that investigate material and space.

title: Omar Al Gurg
description: A photographic practice grounded in close observation. Omar Al Gurg follows nature and encounters from daily life, bringing a quiet attentiveness to his images.

title: Mohamed Ahmed Ibrahim
description: Organic forms, repeated marks and sculptural objects connect Mohamed Ahmed Ibrahim’s practice to the landscape of Khorfakkan. His work moves between drawing, objects and installation.

title: Augustine Paredes
description: Augustine Paredes works across photography, painting, installation and poetry. His practice considers Filipino identity, memory and the experience of living between places.

title: Dima Srouji
description: Dima Srouji works through glass, architecture, film and installation to investigate archives, cultural heritage and the material histories of place.
